question.text: How much funding will Wild Animal Initiative receive in 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the financial amount (in US Dollars) reported under "Contributions and grants" (Part 1, Section 8 - Revenue) in [the Form 990 tax filing](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466) for Wild Animal Initiative Inc. for the fiscal year ending December 2026.
question.fine_print: If Wild Animal Initiative ceases to exist or no Form 990 tax filing is made for the fiscal year ending December 2026, this question will be **annulled**.

research:
I could not find anything that settles this. The FY2026 Form 990 will not exist until about late 2027, and WAI has not published any figure for money raised in 2026. The key point is timing: under the accrual accounting used for Form 990s, a multi-year grant is usually counted in full in the year it is promised. That is why Open Philanthropy's grants produce spikes in 2021 and 2023, and why money promised in 2025 to cover 2026 would show up in the 2025 figure, not the 2026 one.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2025-08-19: WAI's FY2024 Form 990 was filed. It is the latest one on ProPublica: contributions $2,325,327, total revenue $2,487,849, expenses $3,345,940, net income -$858,091, net assets $6,716,700. Investment income was $160,757. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- FY2023 for comparison: contributions $6,817,971, revenue $6,958,910, expenses $4,413,572. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- 2026 (date unclear): WAI's transparency page now links a "WAI 990 2025 Public Inspection" PDF. The file's storage timestamp suggests it was uploaded around late October 2026, but that is my reading of the URL, not a stated date. The PDF is image-encoded and I could not read the FY2025 contributions figure. ProPublica does not show it yet. [WAI transparency](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/transparency)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet.
- ACE's 2025 review gives WAI's 2024 revenue as $3.8M, much higher than the $2.33M on the 990. The gap probably comes from accounting differences, such as earlier multi-year grants being released for spending. The 990 line is what counts here. [ACE review](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/wild-animal-initiative/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-10: ACE kept WAI as a recommended charity for 2026, one of 8. WAI has now given out 96 research grants worth nearly $6M. No funding gap or matching campaign for WAI was mentioned. [ACE 2026 recs](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/announcing-our-2026-charity-recommendations/), [list](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/recommended-charities/)
- 2026-08 (year inferred): ACE's Recommended Charity Fund gave WAI $339,295, most likely in the February 2026 round. That counts toward 2026 contributions. [ACE fund update](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/recommended-charity-fund-update-august-2026/)
- 2026-08-14 (year not shown on page): an EA Forum post put WAI's 2026 budget at $4,280,000. It estimated WAI could usefully absorb $1.42M to $6.09M more in 2027 beyond current and likely-renewing funding. [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/HDpwbQjes34gkkgKn/five-wild-animal-welfare-organizations-estimate-usd3-8m-in)
- 2026-06-23: WAI announced 13 new research grants totalling $727,658. [WAI blog](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants)
- 2025-11-18: WAI set a 2026 target budget of $4.1M and said it was $267K short of fully funding it, which implies about $3.83M was already covered. That coverage could include reserves or money booked in 2025. The 2025 budget was $3.772M. Open Philanthropy, once more than half the budget, no longer funds wild animal welfare. WAI got its first grants from non-EA foundations in 2025. [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p/funding-priorities-for-wild-animal-initiative-in-2026-1)
- Older post (date not confirmed, roughly late 2024): The Navigation Fund planned to fill the gap left by Open Philanthropy "at least through the end of 2026". WAI said it could not rely on that funding beyond 2026. I found no dollar amount. [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/update-on-the-wild-animal-welfare-funding-landscape)
- 2024-08-06: Open Philanthropy gave about $2M a year, roughly half of WAI's budget. Its final grant covered July 2023 to June 2026 and was booked as part of 2023's $6.8M. Revenue from other funders was $1.3M in 2023, down from $1.7M in 2022. [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/idhTjyNTsyxobijyJ/wild-animal-initiative-has-urgent-need-for-more-funding-and)

## 4. Base rates
- Contributions on the 990s:
  - 2018: $0.09M
  - 2019: $0.72M
  - 2020: $0.61M
  - 2021: $5.09M
  - 2022: $1.72M
  - 2023: $6.82M
  - 2024: $2.33M
- Odd years are high because of Open Philanthropy's multi-year grants:
  - 2021: $3.5M over two years.
  - 2023: a grant announced as $6M, though one database lists $2.5M.
- In even years without such a grant, the figure was $1.7M to $2.3M.
- 2026 is the first year with no Open Philanthropy money. A Navigation Fund grant covering 2026 would land in 2026 only if it was committed in 2026. I could not confirm when it was committed. FY2025 is unknown.
- There is no meaningful seasonal pattern to track. The figure is annual, though small donations tend to bunch up in December.

## 5. Other forecasts
- No prediction market or expert forecast exists on this question. None of the Kalshi markets provided match it.
- Loosely related: Kalshi gives an 85% chance that US GivingTuesday donations set a new record on 2026-12-01.

## 6. Upcoming events
- 2026-11-14 onward: ACE's Matching Challenge runs, but for ACE's own fund, not WAI directly. ACE's fund rounds pay out about twice a year.
- 2026-12-01: GivingTuesday, followed by year-end giving.
- The FY2025 990 should appear on ProPublica, giving the 2025 baseline and possibly showing whether Navigation Fund money was booked in 2025.
- Any decision by the Navigation Fund on funding past 2026 would matter if it is committed before 12-31.
- The FY2026 990 is likely due around May to November 2027.

Sources: [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466), [WAI transparency](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/transparency), [ACE review](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/wild-animal-initiative/), [ACE 2026 recs](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/announcing-our-2026-charity-recommendations/), [ACE recommended charities](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/recommended-charities/), [ACE fund update](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/recommended-charity-fund-update-august-2026/), [WAI 2026 grants](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants), [EA Forum 2026 priorities](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p/funding-priorities-for-wild-animal-initiative-in-2026-1), [EA Forum 2027 room for funding](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/HDpwbQjes34gkkgKn/five-wild-animal-welfare-organizations-estimate-usd3-8m-in), [EA Forum funding landscape](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/update-on-the-wild-animal-welfare-funding-landscape), [EA Forum 2024 appeal](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/idhTjyNTsyxobijyJ/wild-animal-initiative-has-urgent-need-for-more-funding-and), [Impala](https://impala.digital/public/profiles/82-2281466/financials/income-statement)

I found no 2026 revenue figure, and the question can't settle until WAI files its 2026 Form 990, probably in late 2027. The newest filing is for 2024, which reported $2,325,327 in contributions. What I did find points to a funding mix in 2026 very different from earlier years.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-19: ProPublica's latest WAI filing is for the fiscal year ending December 2024. It shows contributions of $2,325,327, which is 93.5% of $2,487,849 total revenue. It also shows expenses of $3,345,940, a net loss of $858,091, investment income of $160,757 and net assets of $6,716,700. No 2025 or 2026 filing is posted yet. [ProPublica](https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/822281466)
- I could not find any figures from WAI's 2025 annual report. The search only confirmed that it was published.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The 2026 Form 990 will likely be filed around November 2027.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-10: ACE announced three new 2026 recommended charities: ÇHKD, Greener by Default and Sinergia Animal. WAI is listed among the five charities that keep their 2025 status, so it still appears to be recommended in 2026. The page is somewhat ambiguous on this. [EA Forum/ACE](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/uaTctowvZ5fj7dCB2/announcing-our-2026-charity-recommendations)
- 2026-08-14 (year inferred): A joint post by five wild animal welfare groups gives WAI a 2026 budget of $4,280,000 and 2027 room for more funding of $1.42M to $6.09M. [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/HDpwbQjes34gkkgKn/five-wild-animal-welfare-organizations-estimate-usd3-8m-in)
- 2026 (around August): WAI received $339,295 from ACE's Recommended Charity Fund, most likely from the February 2026 distribution. [ACE](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/blog/recommended-charity-fund-update-august-2026/)
- 2026: WAI awarded 13 research grants totaling $727,658. This is money WAI paid out, not revenue. Its Validation, Welfare Ecology and Seed grant calls closed 2026-10-31. [WAI](https://www.wildanimalinitiative.org/blog/2026-grants)
- 2026-06-30: WAI's last Open Philanthropy grant ended. It was worth $2M per year. [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/update-on-the-wild-animal-welfare-funding-landscape)
- 2025-11-18: WAI's "Funding priorities for 2026" post:
  - 2025 budget: $3,772,000
  - 2026 target: $4,100,000
  - Gap at the time: $267,000 short of target
  - Aspirational extra room: about $3.1M
  - It says OP had covered more than half the budget but "no longer funds wild animal welfare", and that WAI got its first grants from non-EA foundations in 2025.

  [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/s/jTAPdwYry3zTyifkZ/p/wJnEm7hbKBvDaAa6p)
- 2025-11-14: WAI's Science Director called "$3M per year" the current budget and noted "some evidence of new funding outside of EA." [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/kizAAxyNkDtwShEJ2/wild-animal-initiative-when-does-research-become-impact)
- 2024-10-02: Good Ventures barred OP from funding wild animal welfare.
  - The Navigation Fund (TNF) made a non-binding commitment of about $1M to cover WAI from July to December 2026.
  - TNF is to decide on 2027 support in late 2026. WAI's leadership put the chance of renewal at "moderate".
  - WAI's goal is to be fully funded without OP or TNF by the end of 2027.

  [EA Forum](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/BL7ennvpCZKXJbbYH/update-on-the-wild-animal-welfare-funding-landscape)

## 4. Base rates
- Contributions from 2019 to 2024 ($m): 0.72, 0.61, 5.09, 1.72, 6.82, 2.33.
- The series alternates between high odd years and low even years. This fits OP's multi-year grants being booked in full when awarded: $3.5M over two years in June 2021, and grants in 2023 that Wikipedia puts at $6M. [OP grant page](https://www.openphilanthropy.org/grants/wild-animal-initiative-animal-welfare-research), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wild_Animal_Initiative)
- In the low years (2022, 2024), contributions were $1.7M to $2.3M, or about 50 to 70% of spending.
- Two things change this for 2026, but the reporting year of the TNF money is uncertain:
  - There will be no big multi-year OP grant.
  - TNF's roughly $1M could be booked in 2025 or 2026, depending on when it was formally pledged. Nonprofit accounting records an unconditional pledge as revenue when it is made, not when the cash arrives. I could not confirm which year.
- If TNF decides on 2027 support in late 2026, any grant that is unconditional could also land in the 2026 numbers.
- Spending has been $3.3M to $4.3M a year, and net assets of $6.7M at the end of 2024 can cover shortfalls. WAI's budget targets are therefore not a direct guide to contributions.
- Seasonality: much individual giving arrives in December (giving season), which is still ahead for 2026. I found no monthly revenue data.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on WAI's revenue.
- None of the markets supplied matches this question. The closest is Kalshi's "GivingTuesday record" market at 0.85 (Dec 1, 2026), which only says something about general US giving.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late 2026: TNF's decision on 2027 funding for WAI. Its size and timing could add to 2026 contributions.
- 2026-12-01: GivingTuesday, then December giving season, including any matching campaigns. I found no WAI-specific match.
- ACE's Recommended Charity Fund distributions and WAI's likely 2026 recommendation, which means continued ACE-driven donations.
- Around mid-2027: the WAI 2026 annual report may give an early revenue figure.
- About November 2027: the 2026 Form 990 is filed and posted on ProPublica.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** Forecasts close on 2026-12-31. The FY2026 Form 990 is expected around mid to late 2027, and the question resolves around 2027-11-15, about 12 months from now. The fiscal year itself still has about 6 weeks to run, including GivingTuesday and year-end giving.

(b) **Latest known value:** FY2024 contributions were $2,325,327 (about $2.33m), from the 990 filed 2025-08-19. The FY2025 figure is not yet readable.

(c) **If nothing changed:** About $2.3m, a typical even year with no Open Philanthropy grant.

(d) **If the current trend continued:**
- WAI's 2026 budget is $4.1 to $4.3m. Open Philanthropy money has ended, and its last grant was booked in 2023.
- The Navigation Fund is filling the gap through 2026. Its grant counts toward 2026 only if it was committed in 2026.
- Non-Open Philanthropy giving grew from $1.3m in 2023 to $2.3m in 2024. WAI also has new non-EA foundation donors and $0.34m from the ACE fund.
- Possible early commitments for 2027 could add to the 2026 figure.
- This points to roughly $2.5 to $3.5m, with a central value near $3.0m.

(e) **Historical variation:** Year-to-year changes are huge, from -65% to +700%, but they are driven by the timing of multi-year grants. Even years without a large grant ranged from $1.7m to $2.3m. A single multi-year commitment of $2 to 4m booked in 2026 could push the total to $4 to 6m+.

(f) **Experts and markets:** There is no market or expert forecast on this question. The best indicators are:
- In November 2025, WAI said its $4.1m budget for 2026 was $267K short. Some of the coverage may come from reserves or from money booked in 2025.
- ACE re-recommended WAI for 2026.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** The Navigation Fund's 2026 money was booked entirely in 2025, new foundation grants are small, and WAI draws on reserves. Contributions would come in around $1.2 to 1.5m.
- **High:** The Navigation Fund or a large new foundation commits a multi-year grant covering 2026 to 2028 in late 2026, all booked in 2026. Contributions would be $5 to 7m+.

**Tails:**
- A 1st percentile near $1.0m would require broad donor attrition plus prepayment timing working against WAI.
- A 99th percentile near $7.2m would require a multi-year commitment similar to Open Philanthropy's 2023 grant.

(c) **If nothing changed:** A repeat of 2024, a year with no Open Philanthropy money booked, would give about $2.3M.

(d) **If the current trend continued:**
- Open Philanthropy funding is gone.
- The 2026 budget is about $4.1-4.3M, and WAI has been diversifying into non-EA foundations.
- The Navigation Fund is covering the gap through 2026, but its 2026 money may have been booked in 2025.

- Putting this together gives roughly $2.5-3.5M, with a central estimate near $3.0M.

(e) **Historical variation:** Year-to-year swings are huge, from -66% to +740%, because multi-year grants are booked up front. Years without a large grant have run $1.7-2.3M. Years with a large grant have run $5-6.8M.

(f) **Experts and markets:** No market or expert forecast exists. Known 2026 inputs:
- $339K from the ACE fund.
- ACE recommendation renewed.
- A stated 2026 budget gap of only $267K, which implies much of the 2026 funding was already secured, possibly booked in 2025.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** The Navigation Fund's 2026 money was booked in 2025, there is no 2026 renewal, and individual giving is soft. Contributions come in around $1.3-1.6M.
- **High:** In late 2026 the Navigation Fund or a new large foundation commits a multi-year grant covering 2027-2028, all booked in 2026. Contributions come in around $5-7M+.

(f) Experts and markets: No markets or forecasts exist. The question creator's range is $1M to $7M.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
- Low: The Navigation Fund's 2026 money was booked in full in 2025, and new funders were few, giving about $1.3M.

(a) **Time until the outcome is known.** WAI's 2026 fiscal year ends in about 6 weeks. The Form 990 will probably appear on ProPublica around November 2027, roughly 12 months from now.

(b) **Latest known value.** For FY2024, contributions were $2.33m (ProPublica, the latest filing available as of 2026-11-19). Total expenses that year were $3.35m, and net assets were $6.7m.

(c) **If nothing changed.** WAI would repeat a "low year" like 2024, at about $2.3m. That year had no large multi-year Open Philanthropy grant booked.

(d) **If the current trend continued.** The odd-high, even-low pattern came from Open Philanthropy's multi-year grants being booked in full when awarded. That pattern ends because Open Philanthropy no longer funds wild animal welfare. Several things are likely to land in 2026:
- WAI must replace more than half of its roughly $4.1-4.3m budget.
- It received $0.34m from the ACE Recommended Charity Fund, with possibly another distribution to come.
- The Navigation Fund committed about $1m for the second half of 2026, if that is booked in 2026 rather than 2025.
- WAI got its first grants from foundations outside effective altruism in 2025, which suggests that funding is growing.
- A possible Navigation Fund grant for 2027 could be booked in late 2026.
- Giving season is still ahead.

Taken together, the trend points to roughly $3m, somewhat above 2024.

(e) **Historical variation.** Year-to-year swings have been huge (0.6 to 6.8), but they were driven by Open Philanthropy's booking timing. Contributions from other sources have moved more gradually, about ±30-50% per year.

(f) **Expectations of experts and markets.** No market covers this. WAI's own 2026 budget is $4.1-4.3m, and as of November 2025 it was $267k short of that target. However, the budget includes revenue booked in earlier years and drawdowns from reserves, so actual 2026 contributions are probably below the budget.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios.**
- Low: the Navigation Fund money was booked in 2025, its 2027 renewal is declined or booked in 2027, and individual giving falls. Contributions end up around $1.3-1.6m.
